rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong word for a lorry or goods truck.

example.english: That goods truck already delivered the goods to the warehouse this morning.
example.traditional: 嗰架貨車朝早已經送咗啲貨去倉庫。
example.jyutping: go2 gaa3 fo3 ce1 ziu1 zou2 ji5 ging1 sung3 zo2 di1 fo3 heoi3 cong1 fu3

rows.note: Use this for a small hand-pushed cart used to move goods or luggage.

example.english: The hotel staff used a hand truck to move my luggage.
example.traditional: 酒店職員用手推車幫我搬行李。
example.jyutping: zau2 dim3 zik1 jyun4 jung6 sau2 teoi1 ce1 bong1 ngo5 bun1 hong4 lei5
